failure: Failure: The counterexample is classical and does not establish fractional corrections for general quantum channels. It refutes the stated analytic-expansion shortcut only; the source does not claim noninteger leading onset exponents for finite Lindblad semigroups. Intake did not independently reconstruct the dual or asymptotic minimization.
interface: Interface: Strictly positive finite classical transition matrices P(t); for a Markov semigroup, transition orders are directed shortest-path lengths.

claims.title: An analytic classical channel can have a square-root correction in its optimized Choi coefficient
